description: This PHP source file defines the 'DataRegistrationService' class within the 'OrangeHRM\Installer\Util\Service' namespace. The class handles sending registration data over HTTP, using the GuzzleHttp client, and includes error handling and logging functionality.

classes.name: DataRegistrationService
